question: Does the unchanged dual-output relation search transfer to directly implemented published signed16 FABM circuits under exact function-preserving SAT admission?
claim_scope: Optimization relative to the approximate FABM reference function, NOT exact multiplication; sampling is proposal generation only. This is a scalability/transfer experiment, not a new SAT or exact-resynthesis novelty claim.
baseline_definition: Two baselines: pinned published FABM with identical registered interface; pinned QUADOL MinHD=0 implementation candidates with maximum-cardinality matching. QUADOL exact restriction follows the exact-function task; no claim of outperforming all approximate QUADOL fronts.
proof: Each proposal: Boolean graph SAT exact equivalence to initial reference. Final endpoints: actual exported primitive RTL combinational equivalence to original author RTL, boundary-register structure checked. Timeout is unproven, no admission.
hardware: All 9 endpoints vendor HDL validated, synthesized, and routed at 15 ns on xc7a100tcsg324-1, DSP forbidden, identical constraints; canonical duplicates reused transparently.
fixed_analysis: Complete all 3 cases before comparisons. Keep all counterexamples, timeouts, no-benefit results. No adaptive parameter/candidate expansion.
stopping_rule: One fixed pass and finite refinement only. Positive physical evidence supports transfer; otherwise retain a boundary, proceed to useful system evidence without endlessly optimizing this source.
